Lemma
[The heat convolution is smooth]

↗ def:heat-convolution-solution ↗ def:fundamental-solution-heat-equation

\group Heat Equation

If $g\in C(\R ^n)$ has compact support, its heat convolution is $C^\infty $ on $\R ^n\times (0,\infty )$.
Proof

\sketch Near a fixed $(x_0,t_0)$, insert a smooth compactly supported cutoff in the kernel that equals $1$ on all differences $x-y$ with $x$ near $x_0$ and $y\in \spt g$. The resulting compactly supported smooth kernel has a smooth parametric convolution, which locally equals $u$.

□
